scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web,events --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm dev:api:infisical" "pnpm dev:web:infisical" "pnpm dev:events:infisical"
scripts.dev:api:infisical: pnpm exec infisical run --env=dev --path=/api -- pnpm --filter @shop/api dev
scripts.dev:events:infisical: pnpm exec infisical run --env=dev --path=/api -- pnpm --filter @shop/api dev:events
scripts.dev:web:infisical: pnpm exec infisical run --env=dev --path=/web -- pnpm --filter @shop/web dev
scripts.db:migrate:infisical: pnpm exec infisical run --env=dev --path=/api -- pnpm --filter @shop/database db:migrate
scripts.guard: pnpm guard:routes && pnpm guard:public-ids && pnpm guard:frontend && pnpm guard:file-length
scripts.validate: pnpm enforce:branch-name && pnpm guard && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.validate:affected: pnpm enforce:branch-name && pnpm guard && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:affected
